title: Push ups + isometric hold + Meadows raises superset
summary: Clip of an upper-body pump superset (push-ups, isometric pull-up hold, Meadows raises) filmed during a snowstorm, set to French rap music. Per the description it closed a day of about 6000 lbs of bench tonnage plus skull-crusher supersets.

claims.claim: NH finished a session with a pump superset of push-ups, an isometric pull-up hold and Meadows raises, after about 6000 lbs of bench tonnage and skull-crusher supersets.
